001package io.github.ai4ci.config.inhost;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005import java.util.stream.Stream;
006
007import org.immutables.value.Value;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnore;
010
011import io.github.ai4ci.abm.inhost.InHostModelState;
012import io.github.ai4ci.config.execution.ExecutionConfiguration;
013import io.github.ai4ci.util.Sampler;
014
015@Value.Immutable
016public interface InHostModelProfile {
017
018        @Value.Immutable
019        public interface InHostModelProfileIndividual {
020
021                int getPersonId();
022                List<InHostModelState<?>> getStates();
023        }
024
025        @JsonIgnore
026        List<InHostModelProfileIndividual> getStates();
027
028        static ImmutableInHostModelProfile from(
029                        ExecutionConfiguration execConfig, double viralChallenge,
030                        double immunisationChallenge
031        ) {
032                return from(execConfig, 100, 100, viralChallenge, immunisationChallenge);
033        }
034
035        static ImmutableInHostModelProfile from(
036                        ExecutionConfiguration execConfig, int samples, int duration,
037                        double viralChallenge, double immunisationChallenge
038        ) {
039                var config = execConfig.getInHostConfiguration();
040                var rng = Sampler.getSampler();
041                var builder = ImmutableInHostModelProfile.builder();
042                for (var n = 0; n < samples; n++) {
043                        var inner = new ArrayList<InHostModelState<?>>();
044                        InHostModelState<?> state = InHostModelState
045                                .test(config, execConfig, rng);
046                        state = state.update(rng, viralChallenge, immunisationChallenge);
047                        for (var i = 0; i < duration; i++) {
048                                inner.add(state);
049                                state = state.update(rng, 0, 0);
050                        }
051                        builder.addState(
052                                ImmutableInHostModelProfileIndividual.builder()
053                                        .setPersonId(n)
054                                        .setStates(inner)
055                                        .build()
056                        );
057                }
058                return builder.build();
059        }
060
061        @JsonIgnore @Value.Lazy
062        default double[][] getViralLoadProfile() {
063                return this.getStates()
064                        .stream()
065                        .map(
066                                ls -> ls.getStates()
067                                        .stream()
068                                        .mapToDouble(InHostModelState::getNormalisedViralLoad)
069                                        .toArray()
070                        )
071                        .toArray(i -> new double[i][]);
072        }
073
074        @JsonIgnore
075        default Stream<InHostModelProfileIndividual> stream() {
076                return this.getStates()
077                        .stream();
078        }
079
080}
